title: 第12章 没见过这么不要脸的
slug: 道君全本免费-道君最新章节列表
content_zh:
而体内的行气经脉就是真气修炼的根基，修炼中有‘筑基’一说，所谓的筑基其实就是将体内那张网一样的行气脉络筑造牢靠，让体内的真气流畅管道能承受高压、能经受高速冲击。一旦将这基础打好了，也就达到了所谓的‘筑基’境界，能放开了耍。当然，基础打的如何，也有好坏之分，基础越好承压能力自然是越大。
他如今在练气境界内尚刚起步不久，离筑基境界尚远。
经脉疏通过程不是一天两天就能好的，这是个细活，需要一定时间，更何况他白天还要露面虚与委蛇。
晨曦一露，他立刻收功，一缕真气收于丹田之中，如一道漂浮竖立的宝剑蓄势待发，气机饱满。
洗漱沐浴，祛除了一身的血腥味，站在庭院中张开双臂迎接第一缕阳光，真气练成，感受着久违的精气盈体滋味。
白天应付了许以天和陈归硕，一到晚上，暂时放弃了其他修炼，立刻进入经脉疏通状态。
日子就这样一天天过去，似乎没人会把主要精力放在他的身上，他自我感觉处在一个被遗忘的角落。
倒是宋衍青老是会惦记着他，三天两头跑来，问他老师的诗词记起来了没有，牛有道自然是软钉子回应，不见兔子不撒鹰。
又几天后，长老罗元功来了，此人是上清宗的传法长老，颇有虎壮气势，三缕如墨长须，给人不怒自威的感觉。相比较起来，长老苏破在上清宗弟子的印象中显得沉默寡言，平常不太说话，而长老唐素素则显得比较尖锐，不知是不是和女人有关。
宋衍青也跟着来了，一行并无他事，正式对牛有道传授修炼功法，罗元功亲临无非是个小小仪式罢了。
尽管如此，牛有道还是挺佩服宋衍青的能耐，能把罗元功给折腾来，可见宋家在上清宗的影响力。
桃花堂内也有祖师爷坐像，拜了祖师爷后，罗元功命随行弟子将捧着的几本典籍传于了牛有道，又命牛有道跪在祖师爷面前起誓，保证不会将功法外泄之类的毒誓。
仪式完毕，罗元功看牛有道的神情其实也颇为复杂，内因自己心里最清楚，说是心中有愧也不为过，尤其是面对祖师爷坐像，更是惭愧，一阵欲言又止后，脸部森严气势放缓，态度温和地叮嘱了一句，“我师兄也算是颇具慧眼，收的几个弟子皆是人中翘楚，你师傅便是其中之一，算是上清宗这些年来少有的俊杰，希望你好好修炼，不要辜负你师傅的临终期望，盼功业有成，也好为我上清宗的将来出一份力。”
“是，弟子谨记！”捧着典籍的牛有道毕恭毕敬，内心实则狂喜不已，恨不得立刻翻看手中典籍饱览个够。
罗元功转而又对宋衍青道：“同门师兄弟应该互相扶助，你东郭师伯仙逝，牛有道无人传功授业，修行上指点迷津为之解惑的事就交给你了，可有怨言？”
宋衍青立刻拱手道：“没有怨言，弟子当竭尽全力！”
罗元功点了点头，随后又在桃花源内游逛了一番，不知是不是因为感慨东郭浩然的早逝，留下几声轻叹，带着一脸惆怅离去。
没了外人后，牛有道立刻如饥似渴地翻阅那几本典籍，两眼放着光，历经艰辛来到这，不就是冲这个来的么。
一部《上清心经》，正是上清宗的正宗修炼功法。
一部《上清拾遗录》，其中则是包罗万千，分了好些篇章，有草药篇、丹药篇、飞禽走兽篇、外事篇等等。所谓的外事篇记载的都是一些修行界的人物事迹，牛有道稍微翻阅了一下，从记载日期上可以看出一直在增补添加。

《上清拾遗录》正是牛有道需要的东西，对他了解行情有莫大的帮助，不过只是暂时大概翻了翻便扔到了一边，主要精力还是放在了《上清心经》上，这是他急切的东西。
翻开这么一看，他就看入了迷。前世为了修炼《太乙》，不知翻阅了多少古籍、拜访了多少高人解惑，才吃透了《太乙》典籍，积淀下的东西对他如今解读《上清拾遗录》发挥了作用，理解起来并不困难，反而有滋有味。
他知道上清宗肯定还有些法门没有交给自己，也不可能一来就一股脑全给他，并无怨言，一步一步来，贪多嚼不烂的道理他还是懂的，手上的东西足够他享用许久。

content_en:
The Qi-moving meridians in the body are the foundation of Qi cultivation. There is a saying of "foundation building" in cultivation. The so-called foundation building is actually to build the network-like Qi-moving meridians in the body firmly, so that the flowing channels of Qi in the body can withstand high pressure and high-speed impact. Once this foundation is laid, you will have reached the so-called "foundation building" state, and you can let go. Of course, the foundation is good or bad. The better the foundation, the greater the pressure-bearing capacity.
He has just started in the realm of Qi training, and is still far from the realm of foundation building.
The process of dredging the meridians cannot be completed in a day or two. It is a delicate job and takes a certain amount of time, not to mention that he has to show up and show weakness during the day.
As soon as the morning light appeared, he immediately stopped his power, and a ray of true energy was collected in his dantian, like a floating and upright sword ready to be used, full of energy.
After washing and bathing, getting rid of the smell of blood, I stood in the courtyard with open arms to welcome the first ray of sunshine. I practiced my true energy and felt the long-lost feeling of essence filling my body.
During the day, I dealt with Xu Yitian and Chen Guishuo. At night, I temporarily gave up other practices and immediately entered a state of unblocking meridians.
The days passed like this, no one seemed to focus on him, and he felt like he was in a forgotten corner.
Song Yanqing, on the other hand, would always be thinking about him. He would come to him every three days and ask him if he had remembered his teacher's poems. Niu Youdao naturally responded with a soft-spoken response.
A few days later, Elder Luo Yuangong came. This man was the teaching elder of the Shangqing Sect. He was quite imposing and had three long strands of black beard, giving people the impression of being calm and powerful. In comparison, Elder Su Po seemed taciturn in the impression of Shangqing Sect disciples and did not talk much, while Elder Tang Susu seemed sharper. I wonder if it had something to do with women.
Song Yanqing also came with him. The group had nothing else to do but formally teach Niu Youdao the cultivation techniques. Luo Yuangong's presence in person was nothing more than a small ceremony.
Despite this, Niu Youdao still admires Song Yanqing's ability to torment Luo Yuangong, which shows the Song family's influence in the Shangqing Sect.
There is also a seated statue of the Patriarch in the Peach Blossom Hall. After paying homage to the Patriarch, Luo Yuangong ordered his accompanying disciples to pass on the several classics they were holding to Niu Youdao. He also ordered Niu Youdao to kneel in front of the Patriarch and swear an oath, promising not to leak any poisonous oaths such as the skills.
After the ceremony, Luo Yuangong's expression when he saw Niu Youdao was actually quite complicated. The internal reason was clear in his heart. It would not be an exaggeration to say that he felt guilty, especially when facing the seated statue of his ancestor. Senior brother is also quite discerning, and he has recruited several outstanding disciples, and your master is one of them. He is one of the rare talents of the Shangqing Sect in recent years. I hope you will practice well and not live up to your master's dying expectations. I hope that your achievements will be successful and you can contribute to the future of our Shangqing Sect. "
"Yes, disciple, please remember this!" Niu Youdao, who was holding the classics in his hands, was respectful, but his heart was filled with ecstasy, and he wished he could immediately look through the classics in his hands to read them all.
Luo Yuangong turned to Song Yanqing and said: "Brothers in the same discipline should help each other. Your uncle Dongguo has passed away, and Niu Youdao has no one to pass on his skills and teachings. I leave it to you to give guidance and solve my doubts in practice. Do you have any complaints?"
Song Yanqing immediately held up his hands and said: "No complaints, disciples should do their best!"
Luo Yuangong nodded, and then wandered around the Peach Blossom Garden for a while. I wonder if it was because he was feeling Dong Guo Haoran's early death, leaving a few sighs and leaving with a melancholy look on his face.
After there were no outsiders, Niu Youdao immediately flipped through the classics eagerly, his eyes were shining, and he had gone through hardships to get here, wasn't this the reason why he came here.
The "Shangqing Heart Sutra" is the authentic cultivation method of the Shangqing Sect.
A "Shangqing Collected Relics" is all-encompassing and divided into many chapters.Chapters on medicines, elixirs, birds and beasts, foreign affairs, etc. The so-called foreign affairs chapter records the deeds of some figures in the spiritual world. Niu Youdao browsed through it for a while, and it can be seen from the record date that it has been added and added.
"The Collected Records of the Supreme Purity" was exactly what Niu Youdao needed, and it was of great help to him in understanding the market. However, he only briefly flipped through it and threw it aside. His main focus was still on the "Supreme Purity Heart Sutra", which was what he was eager for.
As soon as he opened it and took a look, he was fascinated. In order to practice "Taiyi" in his previous life, he read countless ancient books and visited many experts to answer questions before he understood the classics of "Taiyi" thoroughly. What he accumulated has played a role in his current interpretation of "Shangqing Shilu". It is not difficult to understand, but rather interesting.
He knew that the Shangqing Sect must still have some skills that he had not been given to him, and it was impossible to give them all to him as soon as he came. He had no complaints and took it step by step. He still understood the principle of biting off more than he could chew, and what he had on hand was enough for him to enjoy for a long time.
